description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source project. Its main purpose is to retrieve and display log messages related to requirements or requirement versions, used in the context of adding/removing test cases and testing plans. It interacts with database tables to fetch log records and formats the output for display, including some HTML handling for visualization.

classes.description: Class managing requirement-related operations, including access to the tree manager.

classes.name: tlObjectWithDB
classes.description: Provides database table mappings for requirement revisions and versions.
